name: Daily B2B Buying Signals (Google News) -> Contact & Tech Enricher -> Slack & Sheets

parameters.content:
## Daily B2B Buying Signals (Google News) -> Contact & Tech Enricher -> Slack & Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every weekday morning to monitor Google News for B2B buying signals using an Apify actor. It filters for brand-new triggers, deduplicates domains, enriches each account with contact and technology data, then combines the signal and enrichment details. The final enriched signals are logged to Google Sheets and posted to a Slack sales channel for follow-up.

### Setup steps

- Configure the weekday schedule trigger for the desired timezone and run time.
- Add Apify API credentials or token to the HTTP Request nodes and verify the actor IDs, input payloads, and dataset/result handling.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheet, sheet, and column mapping for appended enriched signals.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the sales channel, message format, and any mention or routing rules.

### Customization

Adjust the Google News search terms, buying-signal filters, deduplication logic, enrichment actor inputs, Google Sheets columns, and Slack alert template to match your target accounts and sales process.

## Schedule signal search

Starts the workflow on a weekday morning schedule and sends the request to Apify to monitor Google News for account buying signals.

## Filter and deduplicate

Keeps only brand-new buying triggers and removes duplicate domains so each account is processed once.

## Enrich and merge data

Enriches the triggered domains with contact and technology data, then merges that enrichment back with the original buying-signal context.

## Log and notify sales

Outputs the enriched buying signals to both destinations: appending records to Google Sheets and alerting the sales team in Slack.
